ambiguity_resolutions.basis: P1498 and P1499 isolate simplicity of the current Prym as the exact obstruction; varying the branch parameter changes that obstruction without changing several mechanisms at once.
ambiguity_resolutions.question: Which cover family is tested first?
ambiguity_resolutions.resolution: Start with the same cyclic cubic model while varying the public branch parameter over every admissible value, then include a matched random low-degree-cover control.

ambiguity_resolutions.basis: A reducible Frobenius polynomial alone is not an algorithm and aggregate-only maps reduce to PO73.
ambiguity_resolutions.question: What counts as a useful split factor?
ambiguity_resolutions.resolution: Require an explicit base-field map to an elliptic factor and prove its restriction is not a function of the E pushforward aggregate.
